extracted.name: Big James' Pork Rub
extracted.description: This pork shoulder rub is a homemade spice blend for Boston butt made with pantry staples, including paprika, chili powder, sugar, cayenne, and cumin.
instruction_lines: Mix together paprika, chili powder, both sugars, celery seed, black pepper, cayenne pepper, dry mustard, garlic powder, cumin, and salt in a bowl.
Store in an airtight container or keep in the freezer in a resealable plastic bag.
